title: 7 Best Herbal Tinctures For Grief
description: Melissa officinalis tinctures have been traditionally used to treat the grief ailment, also known as melancholia, due to its anxiolytic and adaptogenic properties. This herbal preparation helps to alleviate the symptoms of grief by promoting relaxation, reducing anxiety and stress, and enhancing mood stability.
